entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Um, I'm calling about a jersey I ordered. I'm just so confused by the website. I think I need to send it back.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, it's Alex Chen. The order number is... uh, hold on... VF88761. I tried looking at the return policy online, but it was just so much information. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Alex. That's what I'm here for. Let me pull up that order. VF88761... I see it here. It's for the Pro-Line Racing Jersey. What seems to be the issue with it?
It's the wrong size. I thought I ordered a medium, but it's just way too tight in the shoulders. I really need to get a large instead.
Okay, so you'd like to do an exchange for a different size. Let me just check the purchase date... I see it was delivered 62 days ago.
Is that a problem? I couldn't figure out the timeline. I just want to exchange it, it's never even been worn.
Not a problem at all. According to our policy, standard items like this jersey have a 90-day return window. You are well within that period.
Oh, thank goodness. So you can help me? I was so worried.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the exchange process for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a pre-paid return label. Just pack the original jersey back in its packaging, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the size Large to you.
Wow, that's so much easier. Thank you, Sarah. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
